simple.meaning: מִרְעֶה (mirʻeh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “pasture (the place or the act); also the haunt of wild animals.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 47:4. The surrounding context includes flock, kingship, land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִרְעֶה (H4829) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.short: pasture (the place or the act); also the haunt of wild animals
definitions.full: H4829. mireh מִרְעֶה noun masculine Ezek 34:14 pasturage, pasture ; — absolute ׳מ Gen 47:4 +; construct מִרְעֵה Isa 34:14 ; suffix מִרְעֵהוּ Job 39:8 , מִעֵיכֶם Ezek 34:8 ; — pasturage , לַצּאֹן Gen 47:4 (J), compare 1Chr 4:39 , 41 , also Isa 32:14 ; ׳מ וָטוֺב שָׂמֵן Isaiah 32:40, compare (figurative) Ezek 34:14 (twice in verse); 34:18 a; of cattle Joel 1:18 , stag Lam 1:6 ; = pasture , of wild ass Job 39:8 ; of כְּפִירִים Nahum 2:12 (but read מְעָרָה cave , for מרעה , We Now, || מָעוֺן ); מִרְעֵיכֶם יֶתֶר Ezek 34:18 b (figurative).

occurrences.englishText: They also said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.”
They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
They found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful; for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents. The Meunim who were found there, and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place; because there was pasture there for their flocks.
The range of the mountains is his pasture,
For the palace will be forsaken.
All majesty has departed from the daughter of Zion.
I will feed them with good pasture; and their fold will be on the mountains of the height of Israel. There they will lie down in a good fold. They will feed on fat pasture on the mountains of Israel.
